description: This file defines functions and a wizard for setting up Slack integrations, including resolving allowlists and group allowlists, and configuring Slack-specific settings within a larger plugin SDK.

methods.name: resolveSlackAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Resolves a list of Slack allow-from entries, optionally using a token, returning a list of allow-from entries with resolved IDs.

methods.name: promptSlackAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts the user to configure Slack allowlist entries, resolving usernames or IDs, and returning updated configuration.

methods.name: resolveSlackGroupAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves a list of Slack group allowlist entries, attempting to resolve channel IDs, and handling unresolved entries.
